entities.name: Vladimir Kuzmanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir Kuzmanović is a Serbian professional basketball administrator and former player. He played as a guard. His most significant achievement came in 2005, when he won the FIBA Europe Cup with CSU Asesoft Ploiesti and he was selected the Final Four MVP.
